category_title: Unmotivated rising first graders with significant letter-sound recognition deficits and high interest in specific machinery
scenario_title: Initial oral reading assessment and attitude evaluation
minimal_context: Derek and his tutor are sitting in the Literacy Corner of a college library, where Derek is answering questions about his attitude toward reading and attempting to read a pre-primer word list.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's start by talking about reading. Do you like to read for fun?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Umm, no. I like to play outside.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. What is your favorite book to read?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Don ’t have one. I like tractors though.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this list of words on the paper. Try to read as many as you can out loud.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the list) I... (Stops and looks away) It’s not fun because I can ’t. No, that is never fun.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's start by talking about reading. Do you like to read for fun?

STUDENT: Umm, no. I like to play outside.

TUTOR: Okay. What is your favorite book to read?

STUDENT: Don ’t have one. I like tractors though.

TUTOR: Let's look at this list of words on the paper. Try to read as many as you can out loud.

STUDENT: (Looks at the list) I... (Stops and looks away) It’s not fun because I can ’t. No, that is never fun.

task.content: Attempting to read the pre-primer word list from the Qualitative Reading Inventory (QRI) and answering open-ended questions to assess attitude toward reading
task.learning_goal: To assess oral reading and attitude toward reading

context.environment: Literacy Corner in a college library
context.materials: Pre-primer word list from the Qualitative Reading Inventory (QRI), familiar texts on Derek's independent level, books about dump trucks and tractors
context.time_context: Initial assessment during his first full week of summer

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When attempting to read the pre-primer word list and only recognizing and reading the word 'I' with only 10% accuracy
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Exhibited academic and emotional frustrations, stated that reading 'is never fun' and responded that he was 'unable to read'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Limited interest in reading and writing; felt unable to read
related_quotes: It’s not fun because I can ’t.
Umm, no. I like to play outside.

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked open-ended questions about reading for fun or reading out loud
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Responded negatively, stating he never reads out loud and does not have a favorite book, though he likes tractors
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Believes reading is not fun because of his inability to do it
related_quotes: Don ’t have one. I like tractors though.
